portal_description:
The Eclipse Platform is designed for building integrated development
environments (IDEs), server-side applications, desktop applications, and
everything in between. The devtoolset-3-eclipse packages provide the Red Hat
Developer Toolset version of Eclipse.

This update adds the following packages, which require the updated maven30
Software Collection from Red Hat Software Collections 2.0:

* devtoolset-3-cbi-plugins
* devtoolset-3-decentxml
* devtoolset-3-tycho
* devtoolset-3-tycho-extras 

(BZ#1184224)

Users of devtoolset-3-eclipse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages,
which add this enhancement.
